criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 29 April 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 29 April 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.5 is stated as $4,950,000 but 10% of the $55,000,000 Purchase Price is $5,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 19 May 2026 (90 days after signing on 18 February 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 18 June 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (29 April 2027; 29 April 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 2 March 2026 (423 days).
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $55,000,000 = $5,500,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $4,950,000.
Checks whether computed deadlines fall on a weekend and adjusts them under the documents' Business Day definition.
